items.title: O'Reilly Automotive (ORLY) Could Be 23% Undervalued After 232 Store Expansion Plan
items.summary: O'Reilly Automotive (ORLY) has put expansion front and center, with plans to open a record 232 stores in 2026, including new locations across underserved U.S., Mexican, and Canadian markets.
